meta.note: Supermarket locations and hours are approximate. Always verify opening hours on the chain's website or app — hours can change for public holidays and Anzac Day (typically closed morning, open from 1pm).

stores.name: Woolworths Maleny
stores.notes: Full supermarket in the heart of Maleny. Short walk from village accommodation. Good for a complete grocery shop before heading to your cabin or cottage.

stores.name: Seasons IGA Maleny
stores.notes: Local independent supermarket on Maleny's main street. Great range of local hinterland produce, deli, and essentials. Community-focused with friendly service.

stores.name: IGA X-press Montville
stores.notes: Convenient smaller supermarket right on Montville's Gallery Walk. Perfect for quick top-ups and essentials while staying in the Montville area.

stores.name: Mapleton IGA
stores.address: Flaxton Drive, Mapleton QLD 4560 (also BP service station)
stores.notes: Local community supermarket and BP servo in one. Great for Mapleton and Flaxton families. Recently added post office services. Good for fuel, groceries, and局部 supplies.

stores.name: Woolworths Beerwah
stores.notes: Full Woolworths near the Glass House Mountains and Australia Zoo. Best major supermarket for families staying in the Beerwah or Landsborough area.

stores.name: IGA Beerwah
stores.notes: Local independent supermarket in Beerwah. Good alternative to the major chains with local products and friendly service. Convenient for Glass House Mountains accommodation.
